title: Skin or Skim? Inside Investment and Hedge Fund Performance
eligible_reason: Not a DiD design. Fund-month panel regressions of hedge-fund excess returns (Fung-Hsieh alpha) on the continuous insider-ownership share OwnedYouorRelated (or log dollar inside investment), log gross assets and three lagged returns, with inception-year, strategy, firm, fund, month or firm-by-month FE (Analysis - Tables.R lines 1831-1868 and the Table 10 robustness loops). Flow-performance regressions use return-tercile dummies x high_ownership; open-for-investment regressions are cross-sectional associations. The event-time figure (Analysis - Figures.R ~line 1745) plots average cumulative returns around new-fund launches, with no regression. No binary adoption-timing treatment.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm). Main tables: excessMonthlyReturn.FH ~ OwnedYouorRelated + log(1+GrossAssetValue) + lag1-3 returns | inception year + firm/fund/firm-month + strategy + date FE, clustered by date (and fund). Outcomes: Fung-Hsieh and style-adjusted excess returns, flows, AUM.

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous insider-ownership share; lagged outcomes (lag1-3 returns) and size controls; not an adoption-timing design
flow-performance regression with return-tercile dummies x high_ownership interactions and time-varying controls

data_files_note: readme.pdf: Form ADV (SEC FOIA), Fama-French/Fung-Hsieh factors, currency and macro files are shipped; the commercial hedge-fund databases (BarclayHedge, HFR, eVestment, CISDM, EurekaHedge) and the merged hf.merged/adv.hf.clean files that hold fund returns 'we are not able to release'.
data_provenance_note: Outcome data (hedge-fund returns, AUM) come from commercial databases that are not in the package.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Continuous inside-investment regressor; no staggered binary treatment; returns data not shipped.
